title: The Seven Seals
intro: The Lamb opens the seven seals on the scroll. Each seal triggers events in the end times.

items.title: White Horse
items.text: The rider has a bow and a crown - he goes out to conquer.

items.title: Red Horse
items.text: The rider takes peace from the earth - people kill each other.

items.title: Black Horse
items.text: The rider holds a scale - famine and high prices.

items.title: Pale Horse
items.text: The rider is named Death, with Hades following him. Power over a fourth of the earth.

items.title: The Cry of the Martyrs
items.text: Under the altar, souls cry out: "How long before you judge?"

items.title: Earthquake and Signs
items.text: Great earthquake, sun turns black, moon like blood, stars fall.

items.title: Silence in Heaven
items.text: Silence for half an hour. The seven trumpets are prepared.
